official_rules.reason: Ten C-problem statement/data/template files match official archive byte-for-byte; see artifacts/source-verification/official-input-comparison.json. Formatting PDF is a separately supplied local reference.

objectives: Minimize actual bill under unchanged contract settlement and causal information
Compare frozen policies over334days with initial/final inventory6000
Prefer verifiable simpler modules when added complexity lacks stable benefit
decision_variables: emergency purchase e and spill s
constraints: current floating price hidden until after action
ambiguities: Return-credit interpretation preserved from baseline: half-price net refund
Price-disclosure timestamps absent: preserve previous-ended-slot availability assumption
Core nonmidnight tail ignores explicitly completed residual-contract delivery costs
assumptions: No unprovided degradation/self-discharge/grid-cap parameters in primary results
Finite empirical mature-block model is an approximation, not the true process law
January development only; February-December does not choose hyperparameters

candidates.name: legacy_affine_M0
candidates.target_output: Frozen two-midnight causal affine contracts and three-bin inventory feedback
candidates.failure_mode: Horizon truncation and coarse external state
candidates.diagnostic: Matched-endpoint annual bills and reproduction gate
assumptions: Same physical system and declared information structure

candidates.name: conditional_affine_M0
candidates.target_output: Weighted mature trajectories with existing convex Markov feedback
candidates.failure_mode: Small conditional sample and scenario smoothing sensitivity
candidates.diagnostic: January staged choices, full annual negative results and paired intervals
assumptions: Same physical system and declared information structure

candidates.name: conditional_affine_M1
candidates.target_output: Empirical VAR innovation and probability-projected external state with convex inventory
candidates.failure_mode: Approximate state sufficiency and fixed future nominal contracts
candidates.diagnostic: Explicit-LP Bellman equivalence and final matched M0/M1 comparison
assumptions: Same physical system and declared information structure

candidates.name: auxiliary_SDDP_tail
candidates.target_output: Verified midnight inventory cuts used as a tail alternative
candidates.failure_mode: Auxiliary distribution/horizon lower bound is not true-process causal bound
candidates.diagnostic: Common two-midnight tail comparison and existing independent cut checks
assumptions: Same physical system and declared information structure
